'''2021 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on GEMP, October–November 2021. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] won, defeating [[Justin Branch]] in the Finals.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-online-championship-series-wrap-mht-victorious/ 2021 Online Championship Series Wrap - MHT victorious], starwarsccg.org (29 November 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022202942/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2021-online-championship-series-wrap-mht-victorious.html Internet Archive]</ref>
